subject: A long-lens satellite photograph from orbit, straight down at dawn, of a small abandoned colony on a low rise above a dry creek bed on a dun and red worn-flat plain: twelve pale domes, a landing pad, a radio mast, long field strips gone pale with wiregrass. Grainy, high contrast, slightly soft, like a spy-satellite frame.
card: setup.site, the two sites from orbit (sitesHTML in js/ui.js)
notes: Barrens, the barren world (never the graveyard world). Drawn small, as a 16:9 frame with a reticle over it, so it must read as a photograph from orbit.
